brief: A phone charging station: a closed box with a cover that lets a cable pass through.
costSource: token-equivalent at Muse Spark Open shared rates, info only: the Dedicated Endpoint bills GPU seconds while up (.spend/modal-dedicated.jsonl)

requirements.evidence: Single full base piece:0,0,0 with 6 solid caps (all bearings) closing sides and cover:0,0,0;full;top closing top — check_build meshClash clear, no open faces

requirements.requirement: cover that lets a cable pass through
requirements.evidence: Top cover set to type cable (setCoverType to cable) — cable routing aperture in cover; demonstrated with cable-coil and phone props on top surface f1

finish.summary: Built a 1-cell closed hex box with top cover cable type and all side faces capped solid; phone and cable props show charging use.

events.text: Your charging station — a closed box with a cable pass-through coming up.

result.note: A cover goes on an open top or side face of a base. No place on the build takes this part right now. Change the build so it can (for example add the cells it needs beside or below it), then ask again. Guessing raw ops for a part with no offers rarely works.

events.text: You've got the base and lid — now I'll seal it into a closed box with a cable pass-through.

result.note: A cap closes an open edge face; capOpenFaces caps them all. No place on the build takes this part right now. Change the build so it can (for example add the cells it needs beside or below it), then ask again. Guessing raw ops for a part with no offers rarely works.
These ops were refused ALREADY_FITTED or NO_CHANGE (that state already holds), so the batch was applied again without them.

events.text: The shell is sealed — now I'll outfit the charging station.

outcomes.message: the prop has no place to rest there: Overlaps the phone.
the prop has no place to rest there: Overlaps the phone.

tryInsteadSent.note: Each prop refused with a tryInstead was sent again as that tryInstead.

result.note: ok covers rule errors only. meshClash must read "clear" for the meshes to be checked and clear.
